title_en: Driving Home for New Year in an Electric Car
note_en: …的是… turns an action into "the thing that": 他最担心的是，高速上的充电站会不会排长队 "what worried him most was whether there would be long lines at the highway charging stations." 的 works like English "what" or "the thing that," and 是 then reveals the content. It's handy for contrasts: 以前过年回家最怕堵车……现在最怕的是充电排队 "going home for the New Year we used to dread traffic jams most… now what we dread most is waiting to charge."
